stem: A line leak appears during irrigation and the supplied procedure allows the technician to stop the event but not repair the line. What should happen?
choices: Use the permitted stop/isolation step, document the affected zone and escalate for qualified repair
Let the leak continue until the event ends
Mark the task complete and omit the leak
rationale: Use the permitted stop/isolation step, document the affected zone and escalate for qualified repair. This preserves the Course 004 measurement, root-zone, nutrition, work-order, equipment or record-quality principle being assessed.
